enum.name: MultistepFilterApplicationOutcome
enum.int: All filters were successfully applied and verified.
Technical failure to apply the filters (e.g. extraction failed or landing page was an error page).
The user navigated away, closed the tab, or accepted a new suggestion before the application could be verified.

enum.name: MultistepFilterPostSuggestionApplicationUserEngagement
enum.int: Engaged with further on-page navigation within session window
Engaged with further on-page navigation after session window
Abandoned within session window by tab closure
Abandoned after session window by tab closure
Abandoned within session window by navigating via omnibox/bookmark
Abandoned after session window by navigating via omnibox/bookmark
Abandoned within session window by navigating back
Abandoned after session window by navigating back
Abandoned within session window by a new suggestion application overriding the active session
Abandoned after session window by a new suggestion application overriding the active session

enum.name: MultistepFilterRetentionState
enum.int: The user is seeing a suggestion for the first time.
The user has accepted the last suggestion which was shown.
The user has rejected the last suggestion, but accepted at least once in the past.
The user has rejected the last suggestion, and never accepted any suggestion in the past.

enum.name: MultistepFilterTaskType
enum.int: Task type for searching flights.
Task type for searching accommodations (stays).

enum.name: SuggestionUserDecision
enum.int: Multistep Filter suggestion was accepted
Multistep Filter suggestion was ignored (e.g. collapsed or not clicked)
Multistep Filter suggestion was dismissed
